## 改了什么 / What changed

## 影响范围 / Area

## 验证 / Verification

- [ ] `npx tsc -b` 零报错 / clean
- [ ] `npm test` 零失败 / green
- [ ] 改到画面的话：附了改前改后的截图或导出帧 / visual change: before/after images attached
- [ ] 相关探针（`scripts/probes/`）跑过，输出贴在下面 / relevant probe run, output pasted below

## 语义 / Semantics
